units: <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 4:6">Tosef. Ber. IV, 6</cite> <he>הכּוֹסֵס חטים</he> he who chews wheat grains; <cite ref="Berakhot 37a">Ber. 37ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11">Num. R. s. 11</cite> (ref. to <he>אש אכלת</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 24:17">Ex. XXIV, 17</cite>) … <he>שבע היו כוֹסְסוֹת זו בזו</he> seven partitions (strata) of fire were eating into one another; Pesik. Haḥod. p. 45ᵃ; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite> <he>בוססות</he> (corr. acc.); v. <cite ref="I00461"><he>טָכַס</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (b. h.) to make incisions, to mark, count. Mekh. Bo. s. 3; Pes. 61ᵃ; Y. ib. V, 32ᵃ bot., v. נָכַס.
to chew &c. Tanḥ. Vayigg. 3 מְכַסְכֵּס בשיניו cut (the bronze peas) with his teeth.—V. סִכְסֵךְ II.
to be gnawed at (by fire), be charred. Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ bot. בשביל שלא תִכַּסְכֵּס (prob. to be read תתכ׳) that it (the log) may not catch fire.
